news.title: BPTP targets ₹3,000-5,000 crore annual sales, ₹1,000 crore rental income in 5-7 years
news.para: BPTP is targeting annual sales of about ₹3,000-5,000 crore while building a larger rental-yielding portfolio, Manik Malik, president and CEO, BPTP, told ETRealty. The company aims to increase annual rental income from around ₹100 crore currently to about ₹1,000 crore over the next five to seven years.

news.title: Panchkula civic body launches extensive survey  in 42 villages to identify building violations
news.para: Panchkula municipal corporation has initiated a comprehensive survey across its 42 villages. Specialized teams are identifying structures built without necessary approvals or maps. Non-compliant property owners will receive notices to regularize or remove unauthorized constructions. The civic body aims for planned and systematic development within municipal limits. Enforcement efforts may face local political pressure despite recent sealing drives.

news.title: DLF to open ₹500 crore Goa mall by March 2027, eyes over ₹150 crore annual rental income
news.para: DLF is set to develop a lavish seven lakh sq ft shopping mall in Goa by March 2027, with a projected investment of approximately ₹500 crore. The mall is forecasted to earn over ₹150 crore in annual rent and has already secured leases for seventy to seventy-five percent of its space. This undertaking is part of DLF's strategy, which includes three retail projects underway this financial year.

news.title: Double royalty row: Stone quarries, crushers, m-sand units across Karnataka to shut from September 18
news.para: Starting Friday, all stone quarries and crushers in Karnataka will halt operations due to a protest against the government's dual royalty collection method. Operators are calling for an end to this practice, with plans to block mineral resource imports into the state. This statewide shutdown will persist until a formal governmental resolution is obtained.

news.title: Lucknow civic body collects ₹6.50 crore property tax under OTS scheme
news.para: Lucknow Municipal Corporation has collected ₹6.50 crore in property tax under Uttar Pradesh’s one-time settlement scheme, the highest among the state’s 17 municipal corporations. It has received 3,967 applications so far.

news.title: Bihar government announces one-time settlement scheme for brick kiln operators
news.para: The government of Bihar has introduced a settlement scheme for brick kiln operators, waiving an impressive eighty-five crore rupees in interest on their outstanding dues. To benefit from this initiative, operators are required to settle their remaining principal amounts by December 20, 2026. Additionally, amendments to District Mineral Foundation rules have been made to enhance project allocation, thereby fostering transparency and facilitating development in mining-affected areas.

news.title: Supreme court slams builders for anonymous complaints against judges
news.para: The Supreme Court has initiated an investigation into anonymous complaints targeting judges and lawyers. This stems from the court's examination of builders allegedly abusing subvention schemes. The Chief Justice hinted at a potential CBI inquiry into these complaints, which are suspected to be orchestrated by builders and certain counsel as a tactic to obstruct investigations. The court is committed to thoroughly pursuing these issues until they reach a definitive resolution.

news.title: Building approvals should factor drainage, sewage impact of projects: D. Thara, Housing secretary
news.para: D. Thara, secretary-Department of Capital Development, MoHUA, called for project approvals to assess the additional burden developments create on drainage, sewage and civic infrastructure. She also proposed greater coordination between developers and municipal engineers and suggested pilot projects to quantify and mitigate such impacts.

news.title: Table Space to invest up to $31 million for 24.9% stake in Philippines-based KMC Solutions
news.para: Table Space has agreed to acquire an effective economic interest of 24.9% in KMC Solutions for up to $31 million, or about ₹291.25 crore. The transaction forms part of a wider investment with Hillhouse in the Philippines-based managed workspace and business services provider.

news.title: Elevate Campuses’ ₹2,100 crore IPO to open on September 23; price band ₹343-362
news.para: Elevate Campuses has fixed a price band of ₹343-362 per share for its ₹2,100 crore initial public offering. The issue will open on September 23 and close on September 25, 2026, with anchor bidding scheduled for September 22.

news.title: Centre to approve two lakh houses for Telangana under PMAY: Union minister
news.para: Union Minister Shivraj Singh Chouhan has announced exciting news: the approval of two lakh houses under the PM Awas Yojana! He didn't hold back in highlighting the shortcomings of the previous BRS government for not advancing the housing project. Approvals from the central government are set for September 18, alongside new initiatives related to crop insurance and the Lakhpati Didi schemes.

news.title: Bhubaneswar: 10 years on, allottees yet to get Dhauli Heights flats, announce mass dharna
news.para: The plight of hundreds of families waiting for their Dhauli Heights residences continues, now extending beyond ten years. These allottees have poured countless resources into what was promised but is yet to materialize. Even with assurances that fell flat and numerous talks, frustrations grow. Families are gearing up for a collective dharna, pressing for governmental action that establishes a clear deadline for possession.

news.title: Chandigarh gets room to grow as heritage panel clears master plan changes
news.para: The conditional approval for Chandigarh's Master Plan 2031 marks a significant step towards future development. This plan will introduce enhanced flexibility for housing and industrial sectors in subsequent phases, while keeping the existing framework intact for sectors one to thirty. Comprehensive infrastructure and traffic studies will inform the execution of these amendments, which are now set to be forwarded to the Ministry of Home Affairs.

news.title: Gurugram: 900 meter buffer zone earmarked, but not even nine meter gap between houses & IAF ammo depot
news.para: A concerning situation has arisen in Gurgaon, where illegal developments have spread throughout a restricted area surrounding an Air Force depot. The Supreme Court has criticized state officials for their alleged cooperation with land mafia, allowing these constructions to thrive despite the clear risks to national security. This ongoing issue reflects a long-standing failure by authorities to uphold laws safeguarding crucial defense installations from unchecked urban expansion.

news.title: NGT seeks demolition plan details from Ghaziabad development body of colony on park land
news.para: The National Green Tribunal has requested the Ghaziabad Development Authority to clarify its demolition plans regarding encroachments on park land due to a nearby colony and industrial installations. They are particularly focused on rehabilitation strategies for the displaced families. A progress report has been delivered to the tribunal, with a follow-up hearing scheduled for December tenth.

news.title: Allahabad HC orders survey of Gulmohar Greens after row over 112 extra flats, CC
news.para: The Allahabad High Court has tasked an advocate commissioner with examining the situation at Gulmohar Greens. This follows differing claims made by residents and the Ghaziabad Development Authority. The inspection takes place on September 19 and 20, with the court requesting a thorough report to address issues of construction and completion certificates by the hearing date of September 30.

news.title: Sanjay Nayar buys ₹90 crore luxury apartment in South Mumbai’s Carmichael Road
news.para: The transaction involves a 4,537.29 sq ft apartment on the first floor of Kamal Mahal, Anand Kamal Co-operative Housing Society Ltd, located on M L Dahanukar Marg, also known as Carmichael Road. The deal works out to around Rs 1.98 lakh per sq ft based on the carpet area.

news.title: Bombay HC sets guidelines for land title on layout with multiple buildings
news.para: The Bombay High Court has introduced fresh guidelines concerning land division in redevelopment initiatives. Upon formation, each society will gain a proportional land entitlement that is safeguarded against reductions from future plan adjustments. Moreover, builders are required to reveal any risks linked to transferable development rights. This decision seeks to address persistent conflicts surrounding land conveyance issues.

news.title: Rentomojo shares jump over 32% in debut trade
news.para: Rentomojo Ltd's shares made a remarkable entry, surging over thirty-two percent by the close of trading. The online rental giant's stock witnessed a robust listing premium across both exchanges. Investors showed overwhelming interest, with the initial public offering being significantly oversubscribed just last week. The company successfully garnered substantial funds through its fresh issue and offer for sale, continuing to expand its technology-driven rental platform.

news.title: HC extends interim direction restraining allotments in Oberoi Realty's project in Gurugram till September 25
news.para: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has decided to prolong its interim order, which halts any new allotments, particularly impacting the Oberoi 360 North luxury housing project in Gurugram. The decision followed a petition from Advance India Projects Ltd challenging the director of DTCP's directive from August 17, claiming non-alignment with prior decisions. Further proceedings are set to take place on September 25.
